name: abapfmt
description: Formatter for ABAP and CDS (DDL/DCL) code: document and range formatting powered by the abapfmt language server.

abapfmt.path.markdownDescription: Path of the `abapfmt` executable. Empty uses the executable bundled with the extension.

abapfmt.configPath.markdownDescription: Path of the `abapfmt.json` (or abap-cleaner `.cfj` profile) to use, relative to the first workspace folder. Empty searches for `abapfmt.json` or `.vscode/abapfmt.json` next to the file and in its parent folders, and then in the workspace folders (for documents of remote file systems).

abapfmt.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the abapfmt language server.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
scripts.package:all: npm run compile && node scripts/check-binaries.mjs && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
